findings.description: Removing the `hasattr` fallback rejects file-like proxies that expose `read` through `__getattr__` on Python 3.12 and later.
findings.rationale: When a multipart upload contains a proxy that delegates attributes to an underlying BytesIO or file, `hasattr(fp, "read")` is true but the runtime protocol check is false because it uses static attribute lookup on Python 3.12+. The changed condition skips reading the proxy, causing multipart encoding to receive the proxy instead of its contents and fail with TypeError.
